pr.title: [DRAFT] V5 CAD-neutral core and Fusion adapter — verification required
pr.body:
## What this PR contains
The isolated Claude V5 prototype in `prototypes/claude-v5/`: typed CAD-neutral cabinet core, expression graph, stable IDs, Fusion adapter, BRep verification, V4 archive and offline tests. **This PR targets `develop` and remains DRAFT; no merge approval yet.**

## Verified G2 evidence — updated 2026-10-14
- [x] User-generated first cabinet in real Fusion **2705.1.30**; fixture A **58/58 PASS**.
- [x] Dado depth 6 → 10 mm: fixture B **58/58 PASS**, shelf 1183.4 mm, both insertions 9.7 mm.
- [x] Cabinet W1200 → 1000 mm: fixture C **58/58 PASS**, shelf 983.4 mm.
- [x] Plywood 18 → 15 mm with W1200/dado10: fixture D **58/58 PASS**, shelf 1189.4 mm.
- [x] User-directed save/close/reopen; measure before/after adjusting dado10 → 8 mm at **15 mm plywood**: two fixture E reports **58/58 PASS**; new shelf **1185.4 mm** (corrected fixture formula; 1179.4 mm was a mistaken human expectation).
- [x] Direct read-only **real Fusion cut audit**: each dado cut has exactly one intended side-panel participant; shelf excluded; timeline restored; overall **PASS**. [Original audit](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/blob/feature/v5-fusion-adapter/prototypes/claude-v5/docs/test-results/cut_audit_20261014_174320_047406.txt).
- [x] CI: foundation suite and expanded prototype tests on Python **3.10/3.12** passed.
- [x] G2 verification task [issue #2](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/issues/2) completed and closed.

Full results and caveats: [FUSION_TEST_PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/blob/feature/v5-fusion-adapter/prototypes/claude-v5/FUSION_TEST_PROTOCOL.md).

## Code/integration review still required before merging
- [ ] Reconcile the isolated prototype's bundled `vandesign` package with the existing `src/vandesign` starter; **no duplicated authoritative joinery formulas**.
- [ ] Confirm exact final Fusion-tested V4 local-file provenance ([issue #1](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/issues/1)); archive and hash.
- [ ] Document the stored initial spec/hash versus current live edited parameter values distinction.
- [ ] Decide schema/version policy and long-term owned-entity mapping without implying the G4 structural change engine exists.
- [ ] Obtain review for integration placement, packaging/import paths and compatibility; **no manufacturing certification implied**.

**Scope caveat:** A–E and cut target checks verify the tested fixture. The user followed a save/reopen test workflow, but text output cannot independently timestamp closure. Original A–E JSON reports have not been committed. The interference result checks joined panel bodies, not arbitrary assemblies.

## Next development stage
[V5 G3 issue #4](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/issues/4) and [Claude G3 handover](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/blob/feature/v5-g3-cabinet-variants/docs/ai/CLAUDE_V5_G3_HANDOVER_2026-10-14.md) on child branch `feature/v5-g3-cabinet-variants`. G3 = **three variants using one core**. G4 = controlled structural change engine.

**PR #3 is intentionally draft/unmerged.**

comments.body: **Claude's uploaded pre-Fusion patch and protocol reviewed (2026-10-14).** The patch could not be cleanly applied verbatim after earlier reporting edits, so equivalent improvements were reconciled in `runner.py`: live parameters (both `parameters_read_from_fusion` with expressions and `parameters_mm` for compatibility), document/Fusion metadata, JSON+TXT reports, partial-build/missing-spec messages. CAD geometry was not changed. Added a mocked report format assertion and V5 suite to the feature-branch GitHub Actions workflow. **31/31 offline tests passed locally** after reconciliation. GitHub CI was in progress at the time of this comment; **Fusion runtime tests A–E remain UNKNOWN**. The full manual protocol is in `prototypes/claude-v5/FUSION_TEST_PROTOCOL.md`. No merge requested.

comments.body: **CI failure identified and fixed — 2026-10-14.** The red X on the previous feature commit was caused by `tests/test_joinery.py::test_invalid`: `DadoShelf` exposed `.validate()` but did not call it when constructed, so invalid dado-depth values did not raise `ValueError` immediately. Added `__post_init__()` to validate upon construction on both `main` (`f5a7ac8`) and `feature/v5-fusion-adapter` (`71ceff7`); no Fusion adapter or CAD geometry changed. **GitHub Actions PASS on main** (run `38497598159`) and **feature PR checks PASS on Python 3.10 and 3.12** (run `38497606520`). This confirms CI, **not** Fusion runtime validation. Keep draft until Fusion smoke test A–E is evidenced.
